en: A sepia-toned historic photograph of a small railway station with several tracks. A freight train with open wagons stands on the left, while a steam locomotive and carriages are visible further down the platform. People are gathered near the station buildings, which are low wooden or plastered structures with gabled roofs. Trees line the right side of the tracks, and a flagpole with a flag stands near the central building. The caption at the top left reads "Axvalls Järnvägsstation."
